text.en: Pet parents frequently note the warm approach of the clinic staff, highlighting veterinary surgeon Dr. Segal and the veterinary technicians for thorough evaluations and post-surgical text follow-ups. While one client noted a brief negative encounter at the front desk, the majority of visitors describe compassionate and thoughtful interactions during drop-off and pickup.

Clients appreciate the low-cost rates for spay, neuter, and dental cleanings, noting that the non-profit clinic fulfills an essential role for low-income pet owners. Reviewers highlight clear pricing and available voucher programs that keep routine veterinary procedures accessible.

title.en: Detailed follow-up calls alongside front-desk variance

text.en: Pet owners appreciate receiving detailed surgical status updates and follow-up text messages directly from veterinarians. However, communication experiences vary slightly, with one reviewer noting terse phone interactions at reception, while others praise prompt explanations during pet discharge.

q.en: Does the clinic accept municipal spay and neuter vouchers?

a.en: Yes, clients report using municipal and community vouchers to cover or subsidize spay and neuter procedures.

q.en: What surgical updates do pet owners receive on procedure days?

a.en: Reviewers mention receiving telephone status calls prior to surgery and follow-up text check-ins from clinicians afterward.

q.en: What services are offered besides spay and neuter surgery?

a.en: Clients report receiving dental cleanings, tooth extractions, and routine pet vaccinations at this location.
The clinic operates in Northridge, with clients noting upcoming relocations or operations alongside Petco partners.
